subject: Post-demo: trial TAC + deployment recommendation for CareBridge AI
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam.li@carebridge.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@carebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: trial TAC + deployment recommendation for CareBridge AI

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Short recap + recommended next steps so we keep momentum: we heard that the three top priorities for CareBridge in the pilot are: 1) accurate triage suggestions (low false positives), 2) sub-200ms median latency for short prompts, and 3) strict data isolation & auditability for PHI-sensitive flows.

Recommended approach (fastest path to signal):
- Phase A (0–2 weeks): Hosted API trial using Redwood hosted endpoints to validate functional success criteria and prompt quality. This requires no infra from your side and gets you live quickly.
- Phase B (2–4 weeks): Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) if we need predictable p95 latency under load. We can spin this up in 3–5 business days once we have an MSA/PO and capacity window.
- Phase C (optional, triggered by compliance): VPC trial for full network isolation — recommended only if your security team requires in-bound controls and KMS key ownership. This will add lead time (typically 2–3 weeks for network config & approvals).

Proposed trial success criteria (for kickoff discussion):
- Quality: triage precision >= 85% on your labeled set (we can use your 500-example eval set).
- Latency: API median < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for 64-token requests under sample load.
- Reliability: 99.5% request success rate over the trial window.
- Operational: end-to-end audit logs available for all requests, and ability to rotate keys.

Owners:
- CareBridge: Sam (technical lead) + Priya (procurement/compliance)
- Redwood: Karthik (sales owner) + Marissa (customer success) + Ben (solutions engineer)

Immediate asks for us to start Phase A this week:
1) Confirm you want to start on Hosted API (fastest) vs Dedicated sandbox (we can provision but need PO).
2) Share the 500-example eval set (anonymized) or confirm we should use your synthetic holdout.
3) Provide a list of IP ranges to allow if you prefer dedicated sandbox / VPC later.
4) If security requires VPC, share your VPC CIDR and point-of-contact for the networking team.

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (basic trial terms), network-checklist.xlsx (what we’ll need for VPC/dedicated).

If you’re aligned, I’ll: (a) open the trial project in HubSpot and (b) get a small acceptance test harness ready so Ben can run smoke runs on day 1.

Thanks — look forward to next steps.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Li <sam.li@carebridge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@carebridge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: trial TAC + deployment recommendation for CareBridge AI

Thanks Karthik — great summary. Quick responses inline:

- We want to start with Hosted API to validate accuracy and flows asap. We are also very interested in a Dedicated sandbox as an immediate next step once we have promising quality numbers.
- Security note: our security team is signaling a preference for VPC if any PHI flows are involved. For Phase A we’ll keep PHI out of the dataset and use anonymized examples. If results are good, we will push for Phase C (VPC).
- Eval set: I will upload the 500-example anonymized set to the Drive link you send today.

Priority features (for the acceptance tests):
1) Multi-turn context preservation for records with up to 1,000 token history.
2) Low hallucination on medication names (we’ll provide a focused list to check against).
3) Embedding-based rerank for top-3 suggestions.

We can start Hosted API tomorrow morning (PST). Priya is copied for procurement and network coordination.

Thanks,
Sam
CTO, CareBridge AI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@carebridge.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@carebridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: trial TAC + deployment recommendation for CareBridge AI

Marissa / Karthik — technical follow-up and checklist for the pilot. I’ll keep this high signal:

1) Hosted API (Phase A) — what we need from CareBridge:
   - API keys: we will provision sandbox keys (no customer infra required).
   - Eval data upload: we need the 500 examples in CSV (id, prompt, expected_label).
   - Acceptance tests: I’ll attach a small acceptance-tests.md that defines the smoke tests we’ll run (latency, correctness, embeddings similarity).

2) Dedicated sandbox (Phase B) — provisioning notes:
   - Lead time: 3–5 business days once we have PO and capacity window.
   - Network: add our egress IPs to allowlist (sheet in network-checklist.xlsx).
   - Size: start with a 4-GPU pool for predictable p95 latency; we can scale up if needed.

3) VPC trial (Phase C) — caveats and requirements:
   - Requires VPC peering or customer-hosted connector + KMS integration.
   - Additional compliance review (KMS policy review + audit log retention agreement).
   - Estimated lead time: 10–15 business days for security signoff + networking.

Suggested acceptance thresholds (to keep objective):
- Latency: median < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for 64-token requests under 10 concurrent users.
- Throughput: sustain 10 rps with <5% queuing for a 1-minute burst window.
- Quality: precision >= 85% on provided triage set; embeddings mean cosine > 0.92 for labeled similar pairs.

Next steps from Ben (me):
- I’ll prepare the acceptance-tests.md and a short Postman collection for smoke runs.
- If you confirm Hosted start, I’ll run a first smoke run within 24 hours of your data upload and report results.

Attachments: acceptance-tests.md (test definitions), network-checklist.xlsx (fields highlighted for CareBridge).

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Priya Rao <priya@carebridge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@carebridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: trial TAC + deployment recommendation for CareBridge AI

Karthik / Ben / Marissa —

We’re aligned with the plan: start Hosted API tomorrow to validate quality, then move to Dedicated sandbox if the initial runs meet the acceptance thresholds.

Procurement notes: I’m attaching a brief procurement intent PDF and a pending PO number (will share final PO within 3 business days). We will *not* send PHI in Phase A. Our security team will review the network-checklist.xlsx and get back with a point-of-contact for VPC/peering if we need Phase C.

Availability: We can do a kickoff call Monday 09:00 PT to hand off the eval set and run the first smoke tests. Please send a calendar invite and the Drive link for uploads.

Attachments: procurement-intent.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Priya Rao
Head of Procurement, CareBridge AI
priya@carebridge.ai | +1 (212) 555-0134
